title: AI Compiler Engineer
description: <p>EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge-to-cloud computing. EnCharge’s robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today’s best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>EnCharge AI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Compiler Engineer to spearhead the efforts in developing and optimizing graph compilers tailored to cutting-edge AI and ML workloads. You will collaborate with hardware architects, and AI researchers to enhance performance, optimize computation graphs, and enable efficient model deployment on EnCharge’s Inference Accelerators.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Architect, design, and implement optimizations for AI model execution on graph compilers to improve performance, reduce latency, and maximize hardware utilization.</p> <ul> <li>Work closely with ML researchers, hardware engineers, and software developers to design and deploy AI models, understanding and addressing hardware-specific challenges.</li> <li>Work on performance optimizations for neural network models, such as layer fusion, operator fusion, and graph-level transformations.</li> <li>Develop compiler optimizations and passes that convert high-level AI models (e.g., from TensorFlow, PyTorch) into intermediate representations (IR).</li> <li>Implement parsing, semantic analysis, and IR generation for deep learning frameworks.</li> <li>Research and integrate the latest advancements in compiler design, ML model optimizations, and hardware acceleration into graph compilers.</li> <li>Provide leadership, mentorship, and technical guidance to a team of engineers focused on graph compiler optimizations.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Ph.D. preferred).</li> <li>3+ years in compiler development, with a strong focus on AI or ML graph compilers.</li> <li>Proficiency in AI graph compiler frameworks (e.g., MLIR, Torch-FX)</li> <li>Solid background in hardware architectures (e.g., GPUs, TPUs, ASICs) and optimization techniques such as fusion, quantization, and tiling.</li> <li>Familiarity with neural networks operators and code generation.</li> <li>Strong understanding of intermediate representations, code parsing, and semantic analysis in compiler design.</li> <li>Proficiency in C++, Python, or other programming languages commonly used in compiler development.</li> <li>Open-source contributions to AI software frameworks and libraries is a plus</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring engineering teams with successful project delivery.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>EnCharge AI is an equal employment opportunity employer in the United States.<br><br>The salary range for this position is $190,000 to $255,000 USD per year.&nbsp;(Per Year: $195,000 to $265,000 CAD | €110,000 to €160,000 EUR | 1,206,458 to 1,754,848 NOK)<br>Actual compensation offered will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. title: Mitarbeiter Qualitätsmanagement / Qualitätssicherung (gn)
description: Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in  Visbek   suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen   Zeitpunkt einen Mitarbeiter Qualitätsmanagement / Qualitätssicherung (gn) in Vollzeit . Informationen über unseren Betrieb In Visbek befindet sich das Herzstück der Plukon Food Group in Deutschland. Hier sind gleich drei wesentliche Bestandteile unserer Unternehmensgruppe ansässig: Die Plukon GmbH ist die deutsche Verwaltungszentrale von Plukon. Von hieraus steuern Management und Verwaltung die Geschäftsaktivitäten. Ebenfalls am niedersächsischen Standort angesiedelt ist die Plukon Visbek GmbH. Hier handelt es sich um einen Geflügel-Verarbeitungsbetrieb, der auf die Herstellung tiefgekühlter Convenience-Produkte spezialisiert ist. Last but not least hat auch die Plukon Agri GmbH in Visbek ihren Sitz. Plukon Agri ist als Partner unserer Landwirte für den Verkauf von Eintagsküken und den Einkauf von Schlachtgeflügel zuständig. Das sind deine Aufgaben bei uns: Du stellst die Einhaltung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Qualitäts- und Lebensmittelsicherheitsstandards sicher. Du planst, koordinierst und begleitest interne sowie externe Audits. Du entwickelst unser Qualitätsmanagementsystem, Prozesse und Dokumentationen weiter. Du arbeitest aktiv in den HACCP-, Food-Defense- und Food-Fraud-Teams mit. Du bearbeitest Reklamationen und Beanstandungen und leitest geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab. Du planst und führst Schulungen in den Bereichen Qualität, Hygiene und Lebensmittelsicherheit durch. Du unterstützt die Fachbereiche bei qualitätsrelevanten Fragestellungen und der Umsetzung von Qualitätsanforderungen. Mit diesen Qualifikationen überzeugst du uns: Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Lebensmitteltechnologie, Lebensmitteltechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Kenntnisse der relevanten Qualitäts- und Lebensmittelsicherheitsstandards, wie IFS-Food, HACCP oder GMP. Ein ausgeprägtes Qualitäts- und Hygienebewusstsein sowie eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und die Bereitschaft, Ownership für deinen Aufgabenbereich zu übernehmen. Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Das kannst du von uns erwarten: Verantwortung von Anfang an mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit allen Fachbereichen. Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem zukunftssicheren Unternehmen der Lebensmittelindustrie. Attraktive Vergütung, Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unsere Produkte und Firmenfitness. Ein motiviertes Team mit offener und wertschätzender Unternehmenskultur. Persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Unternehmen, das sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt. Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Wenn Du Lust auf neue Herausforderungen hast, freuen wir uns Dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb Dich einfach über unseren Bewerbungsbutton und das entsprechende Bewerbungsformular. Wenn Du noch Fragen zu dieser Stelle hast, kannst Du uns telefonisch oder per E-Mail kontaktieren. Du erhältst so schnell wie möglich eine Rückmeldung.   Plukon Visbek GmbH Herr Thorben-Alexander Ebsen Personalleitung Ahlhorner Str. 98a, 49429 Visbek Telefon: (04445) 898 196 E-Mail:  Akquise im Zusammenhang mit dieser Stellenausschreibung ist nicht erwünscht. Bei Plukon bist Du Teil eines führenden europäischen Foodkonzerns Bei Plukon beschäftigt zu sein, bedeutet, an der verantwortungsvollen Ernährung von 265 Mio. Verbraucherinnen und Verbrauchern in Europa mitzuarbeiten. Unser Sortiment reicht von Mahlzeitkomponenten bis hin zu Fertiggerichten und Salaten. Die Zutaten hierfür sind Geflügelfleischprodukte (unsere Basis), aber immer öfter auch Gemüse und alternative Proteine. So haben wir Angebote für Geflügelfans, genauso wie für Flexitarierinnen und Flexitarier sowie für Vegetarierinnen und Vegetarier. Unsere Produkte findet Ihr in ganz Deutschland im Kühlregal von Supermärkten und Schnellrestaurants. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Über uns Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Das gibt es zu tun Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche. Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft. Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen. Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. Das bringst Du mit Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus Was uns wichtig ist Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard. title: Quality Engineering Lead (m/w/d)
description: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das Unternehmen weltweit dabei unterstützt, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu wachsen. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Händlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt. Als Quality Engineering Lead führst und entwickelst du ein Team von Quality Engineers und trägst dazu bei, die Zuverlässigkeit der Commerce-Plattform von Shopware zu verbessern. Du verbindest Mitarbeiterführung mit praktischer Arbeit in den Bereichen Testing und Automatisierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering- und Produktteams zusammen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen und die Entwicklung sowie Veröffentlichung unserer Software kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du übersetzt Unternehmensziele und Produktprioritäten in eine Quality-Engineering-Roadmap mit klaren und messbaren Verbesserungszielen. Du setzt Prioritäten, delegierst Aufgaben und stellst dich direkt komplexen Herausforderungen im Testing. Führe, unterstütze und entwickle das Team durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Mitarbeitergespräche und individuelle Karriereentwicklung. Unterstütze außerdem bei der Einstellung und beim Onboarding. Definiere gemeinsam mit den Engineering-Kolleg:innen die Teststrategie und Qualitätsstandards für die Produktteams. Priorisiere und verteile Quality-Engineering-Aufgaben entsprechend den Produktrisiken, Roadmap-Zielen und Teamkapazitäten. Arbeite aktiv an Testdesign, Testautomatisierung und explorativem Testing mit. Unterstütze bei der Analyse komplexer Fehler und validiere Änderungen, die mehrere Produktbereiche betreffen. Unterstütze Quality Engineers, Entwickler:innen und Product Manager teamübergreifend bei der Umsetzung der Teststrategie und dabei, Qualität frühzeitig in Planung und Entwicklung zu berücksichtigen. Verbessere Testwerkzeuge und -praktiken, einschließlich des verantwortungsvollen Einsatzes KI-gestützter Tests. Nutze Kundenprobleme, Fehler und die Zuverlässigkeit von Tests, um Verbesserungspotenziale zu identifizieren. Unterstütze Produkt-Releases, indem du Testergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken und eine klare Qualitätsempfehlung an die für den Release koordinierenden Kolleg:innen kommunizierst. Das bringst du mit: Erfahrung in der Führung eines technischen Teams, einschließlich Coaching, Performance-Gesprächen und individueller Weiterentwicklung. Praktische Erfahrung im Softwaretesting, in der Entwicklung von Teststrategien und in der Testautomatisierung, einschließlich Ansätzen wie End-to-End-, API-, Integrations- oder Komponententests. Erfahrung in der Definition und Präsentation von Qualitätsmetriken sowie darin, diese gemeinsam mit Testergebnissen und Risikobewertungen zu nutzen, um Lücken zu erkennen und Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. Die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Aufgaben zu delegieren und effektiv mit Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen Engineering und Produkt zusammenzuarbeiten. Sehr gute schriftliche und mündliche Englischkenntnisse sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte und Abwägungen verständlich zu erklären. Deutschkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich. Hilfreich, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich Erfahrung im E-Commerce, mit Open-Source-Software, Cloud-Anwendungen, Upgrades und Migrationen sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung und Testautomatisierung ist von Vorteil. Vorkenntnisse in Shopware sind nicht erforderlich. Wir begrüßen vielfältige Karrierewege und Perspektiven. Du musst nicht in allen genannten Bereichen Erfahrung haben, um dich zu bewerben. Erzähle uns, wie dich dein bisheriger Werdegang darauf vorbereitet hat, ein Team zu führen und die Softwarequalität zu verbessern. Das bieten wir dir: Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert. Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge. Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware. Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy". Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung. Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents. ... und vieles mehr! Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite . Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung! Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Your responsibilities

ALEMI is looking for a Senior Operations Manager to take end-to-end ownership of our operational backbone — from forecasting and production orders to inbound logistics, stock, and cost control.   • Forecasting & product launches — Own demand forecasting and order management with our production partners, and drive new products from setup through to launch-ready operational data in the relevant systems

  • Process oversight & automation — Oversee core fulfillment, returns, and other after sale processes and continuously drive automation and quality improvements

Für uns ist weniger entscheidend, welchen Jobtitel du bisher hattest. Entscheidend ist, dass du unternehmerisch denkst, komplexe Zusammenhänge schnell verstehst und Verantwortung für Ergebnisse übernimmst.

Wir arbeiten hybrid: Dein Hauptstandort ist dabei in Ahrensburg, gleichzeitig freuen wir uns auf deine regelmäßige Präsenz in unserem Hamburger Büro für den persönlichen Austausch mit unseren Teams. Dabei sind deine Kernaufgaben: Selbstständige Steuerung des Bewerbungsprozesses für ausgewählte Vakanzen - vom Verfassen und Schalten der Stellenanzeigen über die Sichtung der Unterlagen bis hin zur Betreuung der Bewerbenden und der Durchführung von Auswahlterminen (Telefoninterviews, Videocalls, Bewerbertage, Probearbeiten) Empathische Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei allen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen (persönlich vor Ort an den Standorten Ahrensburg und Hamburg, per E-Mail und Telefon) Verlässliche Begleitung des gesamten On- und Offboarding-Prozesses Aktive Teilnahme an Feedback- und Mitarbeitergesprächen Sorgfältige Durchführung aller administrativen HR-Aufgaben (z.B. Erstellung von Arbeitszeugnissen, Abruf von eAUs und A1-Bescheinigungen), Pflege unseres Personalmanagementsystems sowie Erstellung relevanter Auswertungen Vorbereitende Lohnbuchhaltung / Schnittstelle zu unserem externen Steuerbüro für die monatliche Gehaltsabrechnung Administrative Unterstützung im Office Management (z.B. Nachbestellung von Büromaterial, Terminkoordination für Dienstleister) sowie tatkräftige Unterstützung bei der Planung und Umsetzung unserer Firmenveranstaltungen Qualifikation Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im Bereich Personalmanagement, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet abgeschlossen – alternativ bringst du erste relevante Berufserfahrung im Personalwesen mit. Du verfügst über erste praktische Einblicke im operativen Personalmanagement, in der HR-Administration oder konntest bereits Erfahrung als HR-Generalist:in sammeln. Du bist ein echtes Kommunikationstalent mit ausgeprägter Serviceorientierung, trittst auf allen Ebenen souverän auf und hast große Freude am Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Menschen und Abteilungen. Der gewissenhafte und absolut vertrauenswürdige Umgang mit sensiblen Daten ist für dich selbstverständlich. Deine Aufgaben gehst du mit einer klaren Hands-on-Mentalität an: Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und treibst Themen pragmatisch und eigeninitiativ voran. Im Umgang mit den gängigen MS-Office-Anwendungen bist du vollkommen sattelfest und du kommunizierst sehr gut in Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch. Genau wie wir begeisterst du dich für die Touristik – erste Einblicke in die Reise- oder Kreuzfahrtbranche sind ein tolles Extra, aber kein Muss. Erste Grundkenntnisse im Arbeits- und Sozialversicherungsrecht sind von Vorteil, aber kein Must-have – was dir an Praxiswissen noch fehlt, arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Team auf. Benefits Neben den besten Kolleginnen und Kollegen der Welt wartet u.a. auf dich: Befristete Anstellung bis Sommer 2028 im Rahmen einer Elternzeitvertretung Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Wechsel von Büropräsenz und Homeoffice 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr bei einer 5-Tage-Woche Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge über das gesetzliche Maß hinaus Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket oder zum PKW-Stellplatz in unserer Tiefgarage in Ahrensburg Vergünstigter Zugang zu "EGYM Wellpass" (Fitness & Wellness) Teambudget für gemeinsame Events Vergünstigte Kreuzfahrten für dich und deine Familie sowie weitere Touristikervorteile Teilnahme an Schiffsbesichtigungen und Veranstaltungen unserer Reedereipartner Perfekte Lebensläufe gibt es selten – und wir suchen keine Superhelden. Für uns zählen vor allem deine Motivation, deine Persönlichkeit und dein Potenzial. Alles Weitere können wir gemeinsam entwickeln. Here's what that looks like in practice:</p> <ul> <li data-section-id="vkpt18" data-start="319" data-end="461"><strong data-start="321" data-end="343">Move with Urgency:</strong> We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.</li> <li data-section-id="1c7e9p5" data-start="462" data-end="598"><strong data-start="464" data-end="483">Take Ownership:</strong> We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.</li> <li data-section-id="1wm6yoj" data-start="599" data-end="751"><strong data-start="601" data-end="624">Communicate Openly:</strong> We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.</li> <li data-section-id="1w7531e" data-start="752" data-end="874"><strong data-start="754" data-end="776">Build Great Teams:</strong> We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.</li> <li data-section-id="jb6f5l" data-start="875" data-end="1036"><strong data-start="877" data-end="895">Raise the Bar:</strong> We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.</li> <li data-section-id="12lc0uc" data-start="1037" data-end="1184"><strong data-start="1039" data-end="1059">Think Long-Term:</strong> We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.</li> </ul> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions">&nbsp;</div></div><h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <p>Lightning AI is looking to hire <strong>AI</strong> <strong>Platform Support Engineers </strong>to join our EMEA Customer Experience team, supporting ML engineers running large-scale training and inference workloads across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and GPU platforms in production environments.</p> <p>This role is not a ticket router or traditional support engineer. You are a technical partner to ML teams - helping diagnose failures, improve reliability, and guide customers through complex distributed systems problems.The problems range from Kubernetes scheduling and GPU orchestration to distributed PyTorch failures, inference latency, networking bottlenecks, storage performance, and platform reliability. You’ll gain exposure to a wide variety of real world AI workloads across industries and help shape the infrastructure powering the next generation of ML applications.</p> <p data-start="0" data-end="53"><strong>We are currently hiring for two EMEA shifts (9AM–7PM CET/CEST):</strong></p> <ul data-start="55" data-end="194" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""> <li data-section-id="1ux398t" data-start="112" data-end="194" data-is-last-node="">Saturday–Tuesday</li> <li data-section-id="1ux398t" data-start="112" data-end="194" data-is-last-node="">Thursday–Sunday</li> </ul> <p><em>This role is hybrid out of our London office, with an in-office requirement of at least 2 days per week and occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this role at this time.&nbsp;</em></p> <h2><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <p><strong>Work Directly With ML Engineers</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner directly with customer engineering teams running training and inference workloads in production</li> <li>Help customers diagnose and resolve complex distributed systems and ML infrastructure issues</li> <li>Act as a technical advisor during high impact incidents and platform degradation events</li> <li>Translate infrastructure level issues into actionable guidance for ML engineers</li> <li>Build credibility with customers through strong technical reasoning and clear communication</li> </ul> <p><strong>Debug ML Infrastructure &amp; Distributed Workloads</strong></p> <ul> <li>Investigate failures involving distributed training, Kubernetes orchestration, GPU allocation, networking, and storage systems</li> <li>Troubleshoot PyTorch, CUDA, NCCL, and inference serving related issues</li> <li>Analyze logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior to isolate root causes</li> <li>Debug containerized workloads running across Kubernetes and bare metal GPU environments</li> <li>Support customers scaling workloads across multi node GPU systems</li> <li>Diagnose performance bottlenecks involving compute, memory, networking, or storage</li> </ul> <p><strong>Improve Reliability &amp; Platform Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify recurring patterns across customer issues and drive long term reliability improvements</li> <li>Contribute to post incident reviews and operational improvements</li> <li>Build internal tooling, automation, documentation, and runbooks</li> <li>Partner closely with infrastructure, networking, and platform engineering teams</li> <li>Help improve observability, operational visibility, and troubleshooting workflows</li> <li>Improve the customer experience through better processes and technical guidance</li> </ul> <p><strong>What This Role Is Not</strong></p> <p>To set clear expectations:</p> <ul> <li>This is not a traditional help desk or ticket routing support role</li> <li>This is not purely customer success or account management</li> <li>This is not a backend engineering role</li> <li>This is not a passive escalation position</li> </ul> <p>This role is for engineers who enjoy solving difficult technical problems while working closely with other engineers.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>What You’ll Need</strong></span></h2> <h3><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></span></h3> <h3><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Infrastructure &amp; Systems</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Strong software engineering and systems troubleshooting background</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes and containerized environments</li> <li>Linux systems knowledge, including networking, storage, process management, and performance tuning</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems</li> <li>Experience with observability and debugging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry</li> </ul> <h4><strong>ML Infrastructure Experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Hands on experience operating machine learning workloads in production or research environments</li> <li>Experience with distributed ML systems and tooling such as PyTorch, CUDA, or NCCL</li> <li>Familiarity with GPU infrastructure and orchestration</li> <li>Experience troubleshooting performance, reliability, or scaling issues in ML infrastructure</li> <li>Understanding of the operational challenges involved in running ML systems at scale</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Collaboration</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Strong solving complex technical problems collaboratively</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Nice-to-Haves</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with large scale model training or distributed inference systems</li> <li>Familiarity with Ray, Kubeflow, Slurm, or similar distributed scheduling platforms</li> <li>Experience with InfiniBand, RDMA, or high-performance networking</li> developer tooling company</li> <li>Contributions to platform engineering, developer infrastructure, or operational tooling projects</li> <li>Experience writing automation, tooling, or scripts in Python or similar languages</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Compensation</strong></h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>We are committed to title: Regulatory Affairs & Entity Corporate Governance Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p class="x_xmsonormal" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"></p> <p class="x_xmsonormal" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Atlas HXM is the global workforce platform built on compliance. We help companies determine how to engage each member of their workforce and then execute with accountability built in — direct Employer of Record (EOR), Agent of Record (AOR), payroll, and compliance capabilities backed by a decade of practitioner-led expertise. Recognized as a category Leader by NelsonHall and Everest Group, Atlas HXM builds Human Experience Management into everything we do, guided by our "For People, by People" principle.</p> <p class="x_xmsonormal">The future of work is borderless, and so are we. Our people are located around the globe — in the U.S., the UK, India, Colombia, China, and beyond. Diversity and belonging are not just values; they are who we are.&nbsp;</p> <p class="x_xmsonormal">We are also committed to making a positive impact. Through our Environment, Social, and Governance (ESG) impact initiative, we are addressing our environmental footprint and promoting social responsibility. Our impact program is central to our vision and culture, focusing on employee wellness, diversity, charitable work, and ethical corporate governance.</p> <p class="x_xmsonormal"></p></div><p><strong>Head of Global Regulatory Affairs and Entity Corporate Governance (12-month fixed-term maternity cover)</strong><br><br></p> <p>The <strong>Head of Global Regulatory Affairs and Entity Corporate Governance</strong> will lead the company’s regulatory strategy, ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations. This senior role focuses on managing regulatory affairs for the organization and providing strategic guidance on governance matters to support our corporate entities globally. The Head of Global Regulatory Affairs and Entity Corporate Governance will work closely with legal, risk &amp; compliance, and operational teams to implement a regulatory framework that meets both local and international requirements while fostering best practices in corporate governance.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>This is a 12-month fixed-term contract for an individual contributor.</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities<br></strong><br><strong>1. Regulatory Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute a comprehensive regulatory strategy that aligns with the company's business objectives and supports its global operations.</li> <li>Monitor and interpret global regulatory changes across jurisdictions and assess their potential impact on the company, ensuring that policies and procedures remain up to date.</li> <li>Ensure that the organization is compliant with all applicable laws, regulations, and standards, including industry-specific regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams to implement regulatory initiatives and ensure effective risk management practices are in place.</li> <li>Serve as the primary liaison with regulatory authorities and lead regulatory filings, and inquiries to maintain a positive relationship with regulatory bodies worldwide.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Entity Corporate Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Continue building and overseeing the corporate governance framework, adherence to best practices, Company Law requirements, and evolving regulations (e.g., Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) requirements) for all legal entities globally.</li> <li>Maintain an accurate and up-to-date record of all corporate entities, including organizational structures, board and shareholder information, and registration and compliance with the corporate legal requirements for each jurisdiction.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure the team prepares, coordinates, and maintains accuracy of corporate governance documents, including board meeting agendas, minutes, resolutions, and annual returns.</li> <li>Oversee the company’s annual governance activities, ensuring the team accurately and timely prepares the board meeting minutes, corporate resolutions, and annual filings.</li> <li>Support corporate initiatives related to entity management, including new entity formations, mergers, dissolutions, and reorganizations, ensuring adherence to regulatory and governance requirements.</li> <li>Ensure the team submits of statutory filings, regulatory reports, and annual disclosures for all entities in a timely manner, overseeing ongoing corporate legal compliance requirements.</li> <li>Ensure effcient ocoordination with local in-country counsel and service providers to manage corporate changes and regulatory filings..</li> </ul> <p><strong>Risk Management for Entity Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify and assess regulatory and governance risks associated with the company’s operations, and develop strategies to mitigate those risks.</li> <li>Collaborate with the risk management function to integrate governance and compliance risks into the broader enterprise risk management framework.</li> <li>Conduct regular risk assessments, corporate governance audits, and corporate legal compliance checks to identify gaps and recommend improvements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership and Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global regulatory and corporate governance team, promoting a culture of corporate legal compliance and accountability.</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, including Legal, Operations, HR, IT, and Finance, to support a cohesive approach to regulatory compliance and corporate governance.</li> <li>Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on regulatory and corporate governance issues, including advising on new business initiatives, acquisitions, and partnerships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in Law or Corporate Governance, alternatively, a degree in Business, Finance, or a related field &nbsp;and a recognized corporate governance certification (e.g., CSQS, formerly ICSA)</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Experience: 8+ years of experience in corporate governance, corporate legal compliance, global legal entity management preferably within a multinational or global organization with a high volume of subsidiaries across different regions</li> <li>Proven experience in managing corporate legal compliance globally across multiple jurisdictions, particularly across EMEA, and an ability to navigate and differentiate between various legal systems, legal entity structures, local statutory filing obligations.</li> </ul> <p>Demonstrable expertise in managing regulatory affairs, particularly with a focus on licensing. Experience with the Employer of Record (EOR) model is highly beneficial.</p> <p><strong>Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep knowledge of regulatory frameworks and corporate governance best practices, particularly across EMEA</li> <li>Strong understanding of international entity management requirements and the ability to navigate multi-jurisdictional regulations, particularly across EMEA</li> <li>Excellent organizational and project management skills, with a focus on regulatory strategy and risk mitigation.</li> <li>Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic mindset.</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies</strong></p> <ul> <li>Regulatory Expertise: Deep knowledge of global regulatory standards and best practices, with the ability to navigate complex regulatory environment.</li> <li>Strategic Thinking: Ability to anticipate regulatory and governance trends, interpret complex regulations, and devise strategies to ensure entity compliance.</li> <li>Integrity and Confidentiality: Unwavering commitment to ethics, confidentiality, and handling sensitive information with discretion.</li> <li>Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively across departments and with senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Adaptability: Comfortable working in a rapidly changing regulatory environment and responding swiftly to new challenges.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>This position description may not describe all duties, responsibilities, and skills associated with this position. It is intended to portray the major aspects of the job. Other duties or skills may be required.</p> <p><strong>What We Offer&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The opportunity to work with a purpose — simplifying global expansion across borders and cultures</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">A diverse and inclusive environment</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Country-specific benefits</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Flexible PTO</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Your birthday off and a day for you to volunteer and give back to the organization of your choice</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Generous Parental Leave Program</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Growth and development opportunities with access to a top learning content provider<br></span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The opportunity to challenge yourself in a high-performing organization and leave each day knowing you have made an impact.</span></li> </ul> <p>Atlas Technology Solutions, Inc. (Atlas HXM) is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: Atlas HXM is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Atlas HXM are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Atlas HXM will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Atlas HXM encourages applicants of all ages.</p> <p>Atlas HXM will provide accommodation on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities.</p> <p>Hiring decisions are based upon Atlas HXM’s operating needs, and applicant merit including, but not limited to, qualifications, experience, ability, availability, and location.</p> <p>This role will be subject to a background check under local law after an employment offer has been made. Employment may be subject to results. In addition, references may be requested at the final stage of the process.</p> <p><em><a ----- HXM will only email candidates from an ----- email address. Candidates should ignore communications purporting to be from Atlas HXM that originate from any other email address. Atlas HXM will never ask candidates or employees to purchase gift cards or otherwise make payments in connection with applying for a job with Atlas HXM.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. You will combine an understanding of how quants work with hands-on technical skills, helping customers identify valuable opportunities, evaluate approaches and take successful experiments into production. You will work with both practitioners and senior leaders, connecting advances in AI to the problems that matter most to their firms. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. title: Applied AI Lead

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><em>&nbsp;</em></p></div><p>EQT is looking for an Applied AI Lead — a delivery-focused engineering leader who brings together technical depth, product instinct, and the credibility to partner with investment professionals, operators, and engineers to turn generative AI from prototype into production. This role sits at the heart of EQT's ambition to become the most AI-literate firm in private markets.</p> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>You will lead EQT's Applied AI function, a multidisciplinary team of applied AI engineers, ML engineers, and full-stack builders shipping high-impact generative AI products across Client, Investment Teams, and Fund/Group. The team consumes Tech Foundations' shared AI platform while owning lightweight tooling and operational practices to move with speed.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>You will lead a team of engineers deployed on high-impact projects to quickly drive results within both engineering and business teams. You will lead with craft, actively contributing to assignments alongside your leadership duties and you will act as a catalyst, helping engineering teams accelerate AI delivery and maximizing AI impact across business teams. You set the standard for quality and delivery across the team.</p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and grow a multidisciplinary Applied AI team with clear expectations for delivery quality and technical craft.</li> <li>Own the Applied AI roadmap in close alignment with business stakeholders and value stream teams; stay attuned to emerging AI capabilities and evaluate where new models, agents, or tooling unlock fresh value.</li> <li>Partner with Tech Foundations, Product, Data, and Security teams to ensure Applied AI products integrate cleanly and responsibly.</li> <li>Serve as the senior AI partner to EQT's business lines — working directly with investment professionals and leaders to translate opportunities into concrete deliverables.</li> <li>Drive adoption of shipped products through enablement, demonstrations, training, and active feedback loops with end users.</li> <li>Track the AI frontier and apply fresh thinking to raise the bar on what EQT can build.</li> <li>Measure and communicate business impact with rigour — instrumenting both engineering productivity gains and user adoption — and hire engineers who understand that judgment about AI output, decomposition skills, and willingness to change workflows matter more than framework credentials.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <p>You are a thoughtful, delivery-oriented leader who combines technical depth with business fluency to navigate private markets. You bring collaborative leadership, sound judgment, and relentless curiosity about where AI creates genuine value in PE.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll bring (must-have):</strong></h3> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; Credibility:</strong> At least 10 years in software or ML/AI engineering, with 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams or strategic delivery in applied AI, ML product, or AI platform environments.</p> <p><strong>Demonstrated AI Leverage &amp; Outcomes:</strong> Concrete evidence of AI-driven productivity gains: a specific product, workflow, or internal tool you shipped with AI; a measurable before/after (latency, throughput, manual-work elimination); and how you measured it.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Willingness to Abandon Habits for Better Tooling:</strong> You've changed your mind on how you write AI systems because a new approach or model capability made the old one obsolete. You ship what works now, not what worked last year, and you bring that standard to how you lead.</p> <p><strong>Working Knowledge of Private Equity &amp; Deal Workflow:</strong> Genuine operational fluency in PE — deal cycles, investment decision-making, portfolio workflows, or comparable high-stakes professional services. You translate vague "investment teams struggle with analysis" into shippable features and know where AI actually applies vs. distraction.</p> <p><strong>Measurement &amp; Instrumentation:</strong> You cultivate a culture of transparency and clarity. You measure impact and productivity not just for dashboards, but to empower your team, identify where we win, and remove barriers to success. You believe that rigorous, data-informed insights create fairness and accountability—enabling you to hire, promote, and develop top-quartile talent who value ‘Owning It’.</p> <p><strong>Stakeholder &amp; Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong> You've translated ambiguous business needs into shippable AI products in close partnership with non-technical stakeholders. You lead across engineering, product, data, and security without formal authority. You've rolled out internal platforms or shared services and know how to drive adoption.</p> <p><strong>Judgment About What's Real vs. Hype:</strong> You follow AI research actively but skeptically — testing whether new capabilities solve problems you care about. You experiment thoughtfully and bring a craft-oriented mindset to your team.</p> <p><strong>Comfort in Ambiguity &amp; Distributed Environments:</strong> You've operated effectively in large, complex organisations across time zones, unclear ownership, and shifting priorities.</p> <h3><strong>Nice to have:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience in private equity operations, investing, or portfolio company engagement.</li> <li>Experience with data governance, security, and AI compliance frameworks.</li> <li>A track record of building strong developer experiences and high-leverage internal tooling.</li> <li>Experience enabling AI adoption at an organisational scale, including training, change management, or community building.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI infrastructure or platform team environments (beyond applied AI delivery).</li> <li>A public track record of open-source contributions, technical writing, or speaking on AI systems design or engineering practices.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We Offer</strong></h2> <p>EQT offers a rare opportunity to shape how one of the world's leading private markets firms applies AI at scale. You'll work alongside sharp minds in finance and technology, with the mandate and resources to build something genuinely impactful. We're committed to a high-trust environment where what you deliver matters more than tenure.</p> <p>Compensation &amp; Benefits Notice We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary, determined based on the role, experience, skill set, and location. Eligible employees may also receive discretionary incentive compensation, awarded in recognition of individual performance and company results. EQT provides a comprehensive benefits offering designed to support employee wellbeing, development, and work-life balance. Benefits include paid time off, parental leave, wellbeing and wellness support, flexible working arrangements, and learning and development opportunities. Benefits are effective from the first day of employment and may vary by location and role.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Inclusion at</strong><strong data-stringify-type="bold"> EQT</strong></p> <p><em>Our vision for EQT employees is to build high performing &amp; engaged teams. Our competitive edge comes from fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, empowered, and motivated to drive business impact. Our commitment to inclusion is not just about fairness; We understand and believe that being a great place to work drives the best performance.At EQT, inclusion is a business imperative and it's embedded into our talent strategy, decision-making, and culture to ensure that every individual and team operates at their full potential. By doing so, we unlock better collaboration, stronger innovation, and superior investment outcomes.</em><em><strong data-stringify-type="bold"><br><br></strong></em><strong data-stringify-type="bold">About</strong><strong data-stringify-type="bold"> EQT</strong></p> <p><em>EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of over three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR ‌​​270 billion in total assets under management (EUR ‌​​‌141 billion in fee-generating assets under management), within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.<br><br>With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.</em></p> <p><em>More info: <a class="c-link" href="http://www.eqtgroup.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://www.eqtgroup.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.eqtgroup.com</a><br>Follow EQT on&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.linkedin.com/company/508278" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://www.linkedin.com/company/508278" data-sk="tooltip_parent">LinkedIn</a>,&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://twitter.com/eqt" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://twitter.com/eqt" data-sk="tooltip_parent">X</a>,&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPkDSny24x66By2G2_B1Okw/featured" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPkDSny24x66By2G2_B1Okw/featured" data-sk="tooltip_parent">YouTube</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.instagram.com/eqtgroup/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.instagram.com/eqtgroup/" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Instagram</a></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-start="488" data-end="674"><strong>Who we are</strong><br><br><a href="https://apollounderwriting.com/">Apollo</a>, a Skyward Group company, is an innovation-inspired insurance platform operating at Lloyd’s of London, delivering data-driven and creative solutions across a broad range of risks.<br><br>Our name reflects our origins. Alongside Jim Hays, Neil set out to create a different kind of Lloyd’s platform, focused, agile and built around people.<br><br>Since launch in 2009, we have grown into a diversified insurance group offering products across Property, Casualty, Marine, Energy and Transportation, Specialty and Reinsurance, alongside Smart Follow and digital and embedded risk programmes. Our experience and unique ecosystem give Platform Partners the best chance of success, from navigating the Lloyd’s new entrant process through to the delivery of their long-term strategy.<br><br>With a team of more than 300 professionals, we continue to grow with purpose, combining underwriting excellence, innovation and collaboration to enable a more resilient and sustainable world.</p></div><p><strong>Your Role</strong></p> <p>This is a key role supporting Apollo's Platform Partner Syndicates (PPS) combining claims oversight, governance and technical claims expertise across a diverse portfolio of delegated and syndicate business.</p> <p>You will be responsible for both the oversight of the partner syndicate’s claim performance and broader claim handling responsibilities as applicable to each partner. The role will also include supporting the continued development of our Platform Partner Syndicates model.<br><br><strong>About Platform Partner Syndicates</strong></p> <p><a href="https://apollounderwriting.com/platform-partners-0325/">Platform Partner Syndicates</a> is Apollo's innovative platform designed to help ambitious underwriting businesses establish and grow their own Lloyd's syndicates while benefiting from Apollo's operational infrastructure, governance framework and market expertise.</p> <p>The model enables specialist underwriting teams to focus on building and scaling their businesses while leveraging Apollo's support across key functions including claims, operations and regulatory oversight.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> description: <p>Senior Product Manager</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> UK (remote)</p> <h1><strong>Job Description</strong></h1> <h2><strong>About Us</strong></h2> <p>Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.</p> <p>We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event &amp; brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.</p> <p>Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.</p> <p>We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Senior Product Manager to join us.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As a Senior Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,&nbsp; from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.</p> <p>You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.</p> <p>If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Set product direction and priorities</strong>, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Define problems and experiences before solutions</strong>, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.</li> <li><strong>Lead product initiatives end-to-end</strong>, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.</li> <li><strong>Make sound product decisions and trade-offs</strong>, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.</li> <li><strong>Develop product opportunities with external partners</strong>, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.</li> <li><strong>Orchestrate successful launches and adoption</strong>, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.</li> <li><strong>Communicate with clarity throughout</strong>, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a strong track record of <strong>owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end</strong>, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.</li> <li>You’re a <strong>strong problem solver</strong> who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.</li> <li>You operate with <strong>independence and initiative</strong>: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.</li> <li>You have <strong>strong business and commercial awareness</strong> and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.</li> <li>You’re <strong>technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering</strong>, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.</li> <li>You’re an <strong>exceptional communicator</strong>, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.</li> <li>You’re comfortable <strong>operating externally as well as internally</strong>, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.</li> <li>You have a strong sense of <strong>product and user experience</strong>, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>The benefits</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary with generous stock options</li> <li>Pension with employer contributions (NEST)</li> <li>Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care</li> <li>Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments</li> <li>A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.&nbsp;</p> <p><br>Privacy Policy: We process personal information title: Principal Statistical Programmer /Analyst Consultant -CVRM
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Are you interested in working directly for a single sponsor while having the security and additional career opportunities that working for a global CRO can bring? Our team says it’s the best of both worlds….</p> <p>ClinChoice is searching for a <strong>Principal Statistical Programmer Consultant</strong>&nbsp;to join one of our clients.</p> <p>ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO with a strong focus on quality, professional development, and supportive culture. As a client-facing role, we are looking for confident candidates with the ability to work independently whilst establishing a high-trust environment with the client’s counterparts. &nbsp;<br><br></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li data-section-id="u5fb48" data-start="362" data-end="426">Leading statistical programming activities for clinical trials</li> <li data-section-id="clpryt" data-start="427" data-end="507">Developing/reviewing <strong data-start="450" data-end="466">SAS programs</strong>, datasets, tables, listings, and figures</li> <li data-section-id="1oswcm" data-start="508" data-end="565">Providing technical guidance to Statistical Programmers</li> <li data-section-id="1uh9d4y" data-start="566" data-end="616">Reviewing programming specifications and outputs</li> <li data-section-id="14zjwcn" data-start="617" data-end="670">Supporting <strong data-start="630" data-end="643">SDTM/ADaM</strong> and regulatory submissions</li> <li data-section-id="z5918x" data-start="671" data-end="742">Working closely with statisticians, data managers, and clinical teams</li> <li data-section-id="inrtp6" data-start="743" data-end="803">Taking ownership of programming deliverables and timelines</li> <li data-section-id="6e50m0" data-start="804" data-end="845">Mentoring junior and senior programmers</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Education and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science (CS), statistics, or related scientific disciplines with 5 yrs. of clinical programming (CDISC) experience; Master’s degree in CS, statistics or related disciplines with 6 yrs. of clinical programming (CDISC) experience.</li> <li>Working knowledge of ICH and Good Clinical Practices, Clinical research, Clinical trial process, and related regulatory requirements and terminology.</li> <li>Good understanding of the clinical drug development process.</li> <li>Strong communication skills and coordination skills.</li> <li>Current knowledge of technical and regulatory requirements relevant for the role</li> <li>Ability to proactively manage concurrent activities within a project</li> <li>Proficient ability to influence relevant stakeholders on programming-related items</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Application Process</strong></p> <p>Once you have submitted your CV, you will receive an acknowledgement that we received it. If you have the requirements we need, you will be invited for phone interview as the first step.&nbsp; Unfortunately, due to the number of applications we receive, we cannot reply to everyone individually if you are not successful.</p> <p><strong>Who will you be working for?</strong></p> <p><strong>About ClinChoice</strong></p> <p>ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO specializing in clinical development and functional solutions for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and consumer health companies. We have over 28 years of proven high-quality delivery and results across all our services, with over 4,000 professionals in more than 20 countries across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Company Ethos</strong></p> <p>Our mission drives our culture: to contribute to a healthier and safer world by accelerating the development and commercialization of innovative drugs and devices. Our employees are the most valuable company asset and they are the fulcrum around which all ClinChoice activities are built and close management and training is the core instrument to develop and maintain highly-qualified personnel. The continuous training keeps the resources qualified in terms of competence and expertise and gives all personnel the clear tools needed to manage both internal and client processes with the same methodology.&nbsp;&nbsp; The success of these core values is evidenced by our below industry average turnover rates.</p> <p>ClinChoice is an equal opportunity employer. We have based our success on attracting, developing, and promoting talent guided by diversity and inclusivity. Our employees come from very diverse backgrounds: gender, race, beliefs, and ethnicities. We recognize this is our strength and celebrate it.</p> <p><span class="ui-provider a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p q r s t u v w x y z ab ac ae af ag ah ai aj ak"><strong><br><span data-teams="true">#LI-DNP</span></strong></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>At Anduril Australia we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface and other domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require Senior Systems Engineers with broad experience to drive the delivery a variety of software enabled hardware capabilities to our customers. Anduril Senior Systems Engineers rapidly develop expertise in new domains in order to architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation capabilities through the entire product life-cycle.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL DO</h3> <ul> <li>Own technology solutions that are deployed to customers, focussed on the delivery of value to the end-user</li> <li>Act as a subject matter expert for your areas of expertise as they relate to the delivery of Anduril’s technology capabilities, including areas such as hardware selection and integration, testing and evaluation, robotic perception, engineering process or cybersecurity</li> <li>Empathize with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment</li> <li>Design, architect, and implement integrated systems, including advanced and sensitive platforms and payloads, that rapidly delivers capability beyond the scope of current systems, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time</li> <li>Contribute to the design and development of technology components across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines</li> <li>Contribute to the design, implementation and execution of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of complex robotic systems, including full lifecycle testing, monitoring and operation.</li> <li>Support vehicle and payload manufacturing, testing and deployment</li> <li>Travel to co-locate with end-users up to 20% of the time</li> <li>Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, including as a mentor for Engineers from differing backgrounds</li> </ul> <h3>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Engineering, a relevant field, or equivalent experience</li> <li>Extensive professional experience working as an Engineer with one or more domains and/or technologies of expertise</li> <li>Ability to exercise extremely high ownership over a complex system, including design, integration, test, and delivery of new capabilities</li> <li>Capacity to work holistically on complex robotic systems across design, implementation, operation and sustainment</li> <li>Capacity to act as the technical owner for a complex subsystem, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution</li> <li>Capacity learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity</li> <li>Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance</li> </ul> <h3>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with the design, implementation and support of robotic and/or autonomous systems</li> <li>Experience working within the defence, maritime and/or aerospace domains</li> <li>Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment</li> <li>Desire to learn and grow in to other roles that require experience as a Senior Systems Engineer, such as Principal Systems Engineer and/or Engineering Manager</li> <li>Desire to grow in to a Tech-Lead-Manager role, with responsibility for line management of engineers, in addition to delivery</li> </ul> <p>Anduril is an equal-opportunity employer, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. If you are someone passionate to work on problems that matter, we’d love to hear from you!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335551550&quot;:0,&quot;335551620&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Benefits</strong></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.&nbsp;</span><em><span data-contrast="auto">For more information, <a href="https://www.anduril.com/careers">Explore Our Benefits</a>.</span></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div class="RichText column1"> <h3 class="detailElios"><strong>Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams</strong></h3> <p class="detailElios">Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.</p> </div> <div class="RichText column2"> <p class="detailElios">To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:</p> <ul> <li> <p class="detailElios"><strong>No Financial Requests:&nbsp;</strong>Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process.
